|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of a '''retired''' Virtual Modern card of [[Virtual Set 4]]. '''Retired:''' the PC removed the card from its Holotable card data on 14 May 2020 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/93e59a42098f52c6d3403ca2f31dc1f76d273f59 holotable commit 93e59a4], “Set 12 CDF updates”) and from its card data on 11 July 2020 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/13fb38362170120e7493306f73f7e9e69f619294 card-json commit 13fb383]); the card data of 22 June 2020 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1b47242db262aae00e9e08886ea67a01d8b4023d card-json commit 1b47242]) still lists it as id 5102, “•Strategic Reserves (V)”, Virtual Set 4. '''No card took its place:''' it sat between Bow To The First Order (id 5101, GEMP <code>204_47</code>) and Force Freeze (id 5103, GEMP <code>204_49</code>) ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/65cd150d20634447a5499d763ac324436158c7a8 card-json commit 65cd150]), and GEMP slot <code>204_48</code> has stayed empty — Virtual Set 4 has had 22 Dark Side cards since. The card image <code>Virtual4-Dark/large/strategicreserves.gif</code> is still on the PC's file server (last changed 9 July 2018). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V4-D-strategicreserves-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-sr4-0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/strategicreserves.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018) (the first commit of the repository; no earlier copy of the image was found). The PC still serves the 9 July 2018 image at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/strategicreserves.gif.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Strategic Reserves”. Text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may cancel a Force drain by placing here from hand a First Order stormtrooper. Your cards here may deploy as if from hand (if Effect canceled by opponent, any characters here may immediately deploy for free).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Strategic Reserves (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 9 July 2018<ref name="img-sr4-1" />. '''What changed:''' “placing here from hand a First Order stormtrooper” → “placing here from hand a non-unique First Order stormtrooper” (the text re-wraps), and the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right. Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “•Strategic Reserves”. It is the last image of the card. Text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may cancel a Force drain by placing here from hand a non-unique First Order stormtrooper. Your cards here may deploy as if from hand (if Effect canceled by opponent, any characters here may immediately deploy for free).”
* '''Retired''' (14 May 2020): see above.
